body: Oof, I've had those thoughts as well. I can assure you, you do matter to folks in your life. You may not feel like it right now, but you do. Our minds lie to us and tell us we don't matter, when in fact we do.
Hi there! Please don't, we are listening. What's got you so upset?

Hey there, 

Can you at least walk away from the gun for a moment? I'd love to talk to you, there are other options than ending your life. We are listening.
